answer: The bond is locked for 54 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the sonnet lockup is upheld by the delta escrow, the inlet audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet thus freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
